correctness.rationale: An exhaustive normal-kernel dichotomy yields all quotient types. Embedding rigidity splits into non-elementary kernels (elements of order >2 characteristic in the generalized dihedral group) and elementary kernels (maximal elementary abelian subgroup rank). Sylow partitions form a product of distributive partition intervals. Elementary abelian quotient fibers are independently counted for normal kernels inside and outside the rotation subgroup. The included exhaustive small-group checker passes; finite checks support but do not replace the proof.

value.rationale: Provides the complete quotient-isomorphism poset, exact count and quotient-self-duality for every finite generalized-dihedral group, including noncyclic mixed-primary and even kernels that are not covered by the motivating cyclic theorem. The separate Gaussian-binomial normal-kernel fiber distribution distinguishes genuine normal-subgroup multiplicities from isomorphism-class counts and quantifies the 2-primary collision phenomenon.
